sloka: ततो ऽवर्धत मे कायस्तदा पर्वतसन्निभः ।युद्धकाङ्क्षी वनं तच्च विनाशयितुमारभे ।। ५.५८.१०८ ।।।।
transliteration: tato 'vardhata me kāyastadā parvatasannibhaḥ ।yuddhakāṅkṣī vanaṁ tacca vināśayitumārabhe ।। 5.58.108 ।।।।

translations.english: "Thereafter, I increased my body to the size of a mountain, intent on fighting and started destroying the pleasure garden.
